name: Package registries
description: npm, PyPI, crates.io and Maven Central package metadata: latest version, license, links, version history, weekly and monthly downloads and dependent counts.

tools.name: Dependents
tools.description: How many packages depend on one version of a package (deps.dev total/direct/indirect; the default version unless one is named). For crates also crates.io's package-wide reverse-dependency count and a named sample.

options.name: registry
options.about: Which registry the name belongs to: npm (registry.npmjs.org), pypi (pypi.org), crates (crates.io) or maven (Maven Central).

options.name: name
options.about: Package name as the registry knows it: npm `express` or `@types/node`; PyPI `requests` (any PEP 503 spelling); crate `serde`; Maven `groupId:artifactId` such as `com.google.guava:guava`.

options.name: version
options.about: Exact version to count dependents for, e.g. 5.1.0 or 33.4.8-jre. Default: the registry's default (latest) version.

options.name: sample
options.about: crates only: how many dependent crates to list by name (0 to 100).

response.about: How many packages depend on one version of a package (deps.dev total/direct/indirect; the default version unless one is named). For crates also crates.io's package-wide reverse-dependency count and a named sample.

fields.name: version
fields.about: The version the counts are for.

fields.name: count
fields.about: deps.dev: packages whose resolved graph includes this version, or null.

fields.name: scope
fields.about: Always version.

fields.name: package_dependents
fields.about: crates only: {count, scope: package, source: crates.io, source_url}; null elsewhere.

fields.name: sample
fields.about: crates only: dependent crates, each {name, version, requirement, kind, optional, downloads}.

fields.name: registry_url
fields.about: Human page for the package on its registry.

fields.name: source_url
fields.about: The primary API URL that answered.

fields.name: warnings
fields.about: Secondary sources that failed or caveats on the numbers.

fields.name: observed_at_ms
fields.about: Unix milliseconds when fetched.

tools.name: Daily downloads
tools.description: Daily download counts for one npm, PyPI or crates.io package as a series with 1/7/30-day sums; last-week, last-month or last-year (capped by what the source keeps). Maven Central has no download statistics.

options.name: registry
options.about: npm, pypi or crates. Maven Central publishes no download statistics, so maven is refused here.

options.name: name
options.about: Package name as the registry knows it: npm `express` or `@types/node`; PyPI `requests` (any PEP 503 spelling); crate `serde`; Maven `groupId:artifactId` such as `com.google.guava:guava`.

options.name: period
options.about: How many trailing days to return: last-week (7), last-month (30) or last-year (365, capped by what the source keeps: pypistats ~180 days, crates.io 90).

response.about: Daily download counts for one npm, PyPI or crates.io package as a series with 1/7/30-day sums; last-week, last-month or last-year (capped by what the source keeps). Maven Central has no download statistics.

fields.name: date
fields.about: YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: Package record
tools.description: One package's current record: latest version and publish time, description, license, homepage/repository/issues links, keywords, version count, a download summary (npm and PyPI last week/month; crates.io last week/month/90 days/total; Maven Central publishes none) and a dependent count.

options.name: registry
options.about: Which registry the name belongs to: npm (registry.npmjs.org), pypi (pypi.org), crates (crates.io) or maven (Maven Central).

options.name: name
options.about: Package name as the registry knows it: npm `express` or `@types/node`; PyPI `requests` (any PEP 503 spelling); crate `serde`; Maven `groupId:artifactId` such as `com.google.guava:guava`.

response.about: One package's current record: latest version and publish time, description, license, homepage/repository/issues links, keywords, version count, a download summary (npm and PyPI last week/month; crates.io last week/month/90 days/total; Maven Central publishes none) and a dependent count.

fields.name: registry
fields.about: npm, pypi, crates or maven.

fields.name: name
fields.about: Normalised name (PyPI PEP 503 normalised, npm lowercased, Maven groupId:artifactId).

fields.name: display_name
fields.about: The registry's own spelling or Maven project name; null when none.

fields.name: latest_version
fields.about: The registry's current default version.

fields.name: latest_published_at
fields.about: ISO 8601 publish time of latest_version, or null.

fields.name: license
fields.about: Primary licence identifier or name as published, or null.

fields.name: licenses
fields.about: Every licence named by the registry or deps.dev.

fields.name: version_count
fields.about: Published versions, or null.

fields.name: created_at
fields.about: First publish time known to the source, or null.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.about: Most recent publish or update time, or null.

fields.name: deprecated
fields.about: npm: whether latest is deprecated; null elsewhere.

fields.name: yanked
fields.about: PyPI/crates: whether latest is yanked; null elsewhere.

fields.name: downloads
fields.about: {available, last_day, last_week, last_month, last_90_days, total, window_end, source_url}. npm: last week/month (api.npmjs.org); PyPI: last day/week/month (pypistats.org); crates: last day/week/month, 90 days and all-time; Maven: available=false, all null.

fields.name: dependents
fields.about: {count, direct, indirect, scope, version, source, source_url} or null. deps.dev per-version counts (scope=version) for npm, PyPI and Maven; crates.io package-wide reverse dependencies (scope=package) for crates.

fields.name: sources
fields.about: Every upstream URL that contributed.

fields.name: registry_url
fields.about: Human page for the package on its registry.

fields.name: source_url
fields.about: The primary API URL that answered.

fields.name: warnings
fields.about: Secondary sources that failed or caveats on the numbers.

fields.name: observed_at_ms
fields.about: Unix milliseconds when fetched.

tools.name: Version history
tools.description: A package's version history from deps.dev, newest first, with publish time, default flag and deprecation; paged with offset and limit. All four registries.

options.name: registry
options.about: Which registry the name belongs to: npm (registry.npmjs.org), pypi (pypi.org), crates (crates.io) or maven (Maven Central).

options.name: name
options.about: Package name as the registry knows it: npm `express` or `@types/node`; PyPI `requests` (any PEP 503 spelling); crate `serde`; Maven `groupId:artifactId` such as `com.google.guava:guava`.

options.name: offset
options.about: Versions to skip, newest first. Page by passing the previous response's next_offset.

response.about: A package's version history from deps.dev, newest first, with publish time, default flag and deprecation; paged with offset and limit. All four registries.
